resolution: Removed the "Me" filter and retained only the "All" filter for both ordered chassis status and stock cars; the change was validated in UAT and deployed to Production.

investigation_summary: D21N BIP had a 4-character limit for Tire Name, which caused the reported issue. Tire Line was blank because the Tire Line value in the D21N file was blank. The Tire Name limit was changed to 7 characters in UAT, approved, and deployed to Production.
important_findings: D21N BIP enforced a 4-character limit for Tire Name.
Tire Line was blank in D21N because the Tire Line value was blank in the D21N file.
The Tire Name limit was updated from 4 to 7 characters in the UAT environment.
UAT validation was completed and approved for Production deployment.
The change was implemented in Production.
root_cause: D21N BIP had an insufficient 4-character limit configured for Tire Name.
resolution: Updated the Tire Name limit to 7 characters in D21N BIP, validated the change in UAT, and deployed it to Production.

investigation_summary: PFB Export returned blank Vehicle Name values for all model codes because the Model Master lacked model-code-to-vehicle-name mappings. The Model Master was initially created from a TCH01 file generated from SC PROD data, but the initial FDP PROD setup did not receive the mapping data. Business provided the missing file, which was uploaded to PROD, and the mapping requirement was added to the initial setup plan for future FDPs.
important_findings: Vehicle Name was blank in PFB Export for all model codes.
Model Master was created from a TCH01 file generated from SC PROD data.
The TCH01 file contained no logic to update Vehicle Name in Model Master.
The model-code-to-Vehicle-Name mapping was not received during FDP PROD initial setup.
Business-provided mapping data was uploaded to PROD.
Vehicle Name mapping was added to the initial setup plan for future FDPs.
root_cause: The model-code-to-Vehicle-Name mapping was not received during the FDP PROD initial setup, leaving Vehicle Name values missing from Model Master.
resolution: The Business-provided mapping file was uploaded to PROD to populate Vehicle Name in Model Master; the mapping requirement was added to the initial setup plan for future FDPs.

investigation_summary: The issue was identified as a pre-existing Sales Order Sheet formatting problem and reclassified from a bug to an Additional CR/AMS CR. Changes to Sales Order Sheet 1 & 2 were implemented and iteratively refined in UAT1 based on user feedback. After UAT confirmation, the changes were deployed to Production and verified.

resolution: Implemented and validated the requested Sales Order Sheet 1 & 2 formatting and text corrections in UAT1, then deployed the approved changes to Production.

resolution: The AMS CR was validated in UAT1 and deployed to the Production environment on 11 September 2023.

investigation_summary: The AMS CR aligned FDP version behavior with the SC version for updating vehicle master "Maximum Mileage" when a JC is closed. The change was implemented and validated in UAT1, approved after UAT verification, and deployed to Prod Environment.

The required behavior is to not update vehicle master "Maximum Mileage" when "Mileage / Operation Hours" is blank at JC closure.
The FDP version specification was copied from the SC version.

The change was deployed to Prod Environment after UAT approval.
root_cause: The prior JC close logic updated vehicle master "Maximum Mileage" even when "Mileage / Operation Hours" was blank.
resolution: Updated the FDP version JC close logic to skip vehicle master "Maximum Mileage" updates when "Mileage / Operation Hours" is blank, matching the SC version; validated in UAT1 and deployed to Prod Environment.

investigation_summary: The required-field validation for BB Work Planned Start Date and Requested Registration Date was found to differ based on the chassis-order creation source. After implementing UAT feedback, UAT confirmation was completed and approved for PROD deployment.

resolution: The validation changes were corrected in UAT following failed UAT feedback, approved after retesting, and deployed to the Production environment.

investigation_summary: Order Allocation and Shipment notification issues were attributed to a technical issue in the CPI Middleware configuration (#520341066). Although the configuration fix and order recovery were completed, some FDP Sales Orders created in D2S from 17-Aug-2023 through 23-Aug-2023 experienced shipment notifications before order allocations due to warehouse processing timing. A follow-up AMS CR, MFTBCFFR-1656, was raised to assess applying the SC countermeasure to FDP Force.
important_findings: The CPI Middleware configuration issue (#520341066) caused the Order Allocation and Shipment notification issues.
For recovered orders, warehouse shipment document creation could cause DMS to receive Shipment notification before Order Allocation recovery completed.
Shipment-before-allocation sequencing creates a risk of part number mismatch.
Some FDP Sales Orders created in D2S between 17-Aug-2023 and 23-Aug-2023 were affected despite completed order recovery.
FDP orders created from 24-Aug-2023 onward were stated not to have this issue.
SC AMS CR#610008069 was released as a countermeasure, and deployment to UAT for FDP Force was planned by 4-Sep-2023 under a separate AMS CR.
root_cause: Technical issue with configuring the CPI Middleware configuration (#520341066), which delayed Order Allocation relative to Shipment notification processing.
resolution: The CPI Middleware configuration fix was applied and fully implemented. Follow-up work to apply the SC countermeasure to FDP Force was raised as MFTBCFFR-1656.

important_findings: The issue occurred when navigating My Quote View -> My Branch View; navigating My Quote View -> My Team View -> My Branch View displayed branch data correctly.
No data recovery was required because no data was lost.
The cause was identified as a configuration miss; only "MF My Branch Quotes List View" was approved for change.
The UAT1 Environment initially showed only three records because the screen has a Pre-Defined query for Last 30 Days Record.
The change was verified successfully on PROD after deployment.
root_cause: A configuration miss in "MF My Branch Quotes List View" caused branch data not to display correctly when users navigated directly from My Quote View to My Branch View.
resolution: Updated the configuration for "MF My Branch Quotes List View", deployed the change to UAT1 Environment for testing, and released it to Production after approval.

investigation_summary: Chassis Orders created from TOB files had Chassis Order Line Items with blank status, reproduced in UAT1 and SC UAT and observed in SC PROD. When a DJ2B Change Order was sent to TOB, line items with null status were not processed, so Product Code and Model Code were omitted from the request. The handling was changed in UAT1 and deployed to Production to include blank-status line items in Change Orders; existing chassis orders were recovered.
important_findings: Chassis Orders created from TOB files could have Chassis Order Line Items with blank status.
The issue existed in both SC and FDP and was reproduced in UAT1 and SC UAT; blank status was also observed in SC PROD.
When sending a DJ2B Change Order to TOB, Product Code and Model Code were not sent for line items with null status.
The corrective change handles null Line Item status and includes Product Code and Model Code in the TOB request string.
Existing Chassis Orders raised up to the prior day were recovered; production verification was pending the next PO change.
root_cause: Change Order processing did not handle Chassis Order Line Items with blank/null status, causing Product Code and Model Code to be omitted when sending the Change Order to TOB.
resolution: Implemented and deployed a change that allows Change Orders for blank-status line items and includes their Product Code and Model Code in the TOB request; recovered affected existing Chassis Orders.

investigation_summary: The issue was replicated on UAT2 for NV Quote#1-1CMP1N, where sales orders with status "Pending" or "Cancel" were considered unexpectedly. Investigation confirmed that the implemented business files maintain only two SO status categories: "Before Sale posting" and "After sales posting", matching UAT behavior. The reported status scenarios were determined to be outside the existing scope, so the bug was rejected and a separate SR was raised.
important_findings: The behavior was replicated on UAT2 for NV Quote#1-1CMP1N.
Sales orders with status "Pending" or "Cancel" were reported as not ordered and expected to be excluded from counting.
The business files maintain only two SO status categories: "Before Sale posting" and "After sales posting".
The UAT implementation matches the configured business-file status handling.
Additional status cases require separate handling: Pending, Pending approval, Cancelled, Rejected, and Sales cancellation.
A separate SR was raised as MFTBCFFR-1631.
root_cause: The requested handling for Pending, Pending approval, Cancelled, Rejected, and Sales cancellation SO statuses was not included in the existing business-file scope, which only maintains "Before Sale posting" and "After sales posting" statuses.
resolution: MFTBCFFR-1628 was rejected, and the additional sales-order status cases were raised in SR MFTBCFFR-1631.

investigation_summary: The vehicle inspection expiration date was not updated correctly when an uploaded vehicle inspection certificate had an issuance date older than the existing certificate and a blank expiration date. Certificates with a newer issuance date did not cause the issue even when the expiration date was blank. The agreed approach was to prioritize a data patch for Okayama Fuso and raise an AMS CR for a code change to ignore certificates with blank expiration dates.
important_findings: The issue occurs when an uploaded vehicle inspection certificate has an issuance date older than the existing certificate and a blank expiration date.
Certificates with an issuance date greater than the existing certificate do not cause an issue when the expiration date is blank.
The file field used for the expiration date is ON_EXPIRTN_DT_VBALIDITY_PERIOD.
Solution 1, a data patch for Okayama Fuso, was prioritized.
Solution 2 requires a code change to ignore vehicle inspection certificates with blank expiration dates.
root_cause: A vehicle inspection certificate with a blank expiration date was processed when its issuance date was older than the existing certificate, causing the vehicle inspection expiration date to be updated incorrectly.
resolution: Prioritize a data patch for Okayama Fuso (Solution 1) and raise an AMS CR for a code change to ignore vehicle inspection certificates with blank expiration dates (Solution 2).

important_findings: D2S middleware system (CPI) was unable to get Allocation/Shipment IDOC.

The issue was fixed.
root_cause: The CR Team missed the required activity during cutover, preventing D2S middleware system (CPI) from receiving Allocation/Shipment IDOC.
resolution: The missed cutover activity was corrected, and the issue was fixed.

investigation_summary: Allocation N000001142 was triggered on the D2S side and received in Siebel, but Siebel ignored it because the Shipment had already been processed. root_cause: The Allocation/Shipment IDOC was missed by the CR Team during cutover, preventing D2S middleware system (CPI) from retrieving it.
resolution: The issue in D2S middleware system (CPI) was fixed.

investigation_summary: The "Manager Position" and "Position Type JPN" fields displayed SC-version position names instead of FDP-version position names. Their LOV values were sourced from database views migrated from SC FORCE with a hardcoded workspace ID and SC-to-FDP position mappings. The LOV condition was updated to remove the hardcoded condition and retrieve values using the correct workspace ID; the fix was validated in UAT1 and UAT2 (RT2), then deployed and verified in Production.
important_findings: "Manager Position" and "Position Type JPN" values were sourced from a database view used by the LOV.
The database view was migrated from SC FORCE, carrying a hardcoded workspace ID into all FDP environments.
UAT1 validation initially showed SC-version position names in both affected fields rather than FDP-version names.
"Position Type JPN" and "Manager Name" used Position Type values retained from SC and mapped to FDP positions.
The LOV condition was changed to remove the hardcoded workspace-ID condition and fetch values for the correct workspace ID.
The change was validated in UAT1 and UAT2 (RT2), deployed to Production, and confirmed operational.
root_cause: Database views migrated from SC FORCE contained a hardcoded LOV workspace ID, causing the affected fields to retrieve SC-version position values rather than the correct FDP workspace values.
resolution: Updated the LOV condition to remove the hardcoded workspace-ID condition and retrieve values using the correct workspace ID; deployed the validated change to Production.

investigation_summary: The scheduled TCB01 package incorrectly changed Chassis Orders from "Shipment Instructed" to "Ordered". The package behavior was based on SC Force/SC Force 2.0 logic involving RF status, which was not appropriate for FDP where RF is disconnected. The corrected TCB01 behavior was validated in UAT1 and deployed to PROD; the package was scheduled and the latest file was processed successfully.
important_findings: TCB01 selected Chassis Orders with status "Shipment Instructed" and RF status "Send Shipment to RF", then changed the order status to "Ordered".
In FDP, RF is disconnected, and Chassis Order status must not be updated by the TCB01 file.
The agreed TCB01 scope was to update Planned Completion Date and K1_1_OK_Actual_Date, while preventing status updates.
Some UAT1 records were not updated because update_date in column 127 was not today or yesterday; updating update_date to the current date allowed the changes to be reflected.
The PROD fix was deployed, the package was scheduled, and the latest TCB01 file was processed successfully after update_date was updated.
root_cause: The TCB01 package retained SC Force/SC Force 2.0 logic that updated Chassis Order status from "Shipment Instructed" to "Ordered" based on RF status, although this status update was not valid for FDP.
resolution: Modified TCB01 processing so that it does not update Chassis Order status and only updates Planned Completion Date and K1_1_OK_Actual_Date. The fix was validated in UAT1, deployed to PROD, and the TCB01 update_date column was set to the current date before processing the latest file.

investigation_summary: Printing to OKYF_10_P03 failed and was investigated through DIS printer and printer-object re-registration. The printer object was deleted and recreated on dms-0 and dms-1 using prnmngr.vbs with the Canon Generic Plus LIPSLX driver and LPT1: port.
The DIS port on dms-1 was found to be incorrectly configured and was corrected.
The recreated printer object was not reflected immediately on the night of August 23; reflection was confirmed on August 24.
Business testing confirmed that printing to OKYF_10_P03 was successful after the object recreation and port configuration correction.
resolution: Recreated and re-registered the OKYF_10_P03 printer object in DISU, recreated the printer object on dms-0 and dms-1, and corrected the DIS port configuration on dms-1. Printing was then confirmed successful.

Account code and Sub-account code must be maintained separately; for example, 255 and 80 must produce 255-80 rather than 25580.

investigation_summary: The incident concerned automatic calculation of vehicle and trade-in consumption tax on NV Quotes in UAT. A reported failure for class "LB" was later retested, and the values were confirmed as calculating correctly on UAT for Quote# 1-283KNN.

The reported UAT scenario for class "LB" involved trade-in consumption tax remaining 0 after entering Trade in amount in a trade in Assessment request.

The incident was closed because the requested behavior requires a Change Request for FDP version implementation.
root_cause: Existing functionality only calculates Vehicle Body price from Model Code and S-body line items; Trailer and Forklift orders do not contain those product types.

The issue occurred when adding line items for Option, color, and tire.
The system attempted to fetch pricing from the VC application during line-item addition.
The VC application API call caused the processing delay.

root_cause: A pricing fetch through the VC application API caused delays when adding Option, color, and tire line items.
resolution: Disabled the API call to the VC application.
